tools.description: Catalog all profile settings with types, current values and prerequisites. get returns direct preferences; set validates and applies an explicit ordinary patch. Access, network and data settings require prepare, native user review, then apply with review_id. review reads approval status. setup requests native review of a cataloged setup operation with parameters; apply starts it after approval, and setup_status reads its operation_id receipt. Tool arguments cannot approve changes. Stop and scoped task grants remain enforced. Secrets and complex private data are redacted. Check applied and persisted independently; some native settings require reload or new tabs. Never change settings without a user request.

block_ai.description: Hide pages and search results whose verdict is "Likely AI-built".

browser_plugin.description: Configure browser plugin. Configure through the matching reviewed setup workflow; raw object patches are refused.

coding_session_plugin.description: Configure coding session plugin. Configure through the matching reviewed setup workflow; raw object patches are refused.

community_lists.description: Opt in to locally supplied uBlacklist community rules. Off by default; this first slice does not fetch or persist list contents.

content_search.description: Opt-in local indexing of public page text for history search.

custom_search_url.description: HTTPS search URL containing exactly one {query} in the query string, without credentials or fragment.

developer_tools.description: Developer tools (F12, Inspect) on content tabs, on by default as in other browsers. Open tabs pick it up on their next load on Windows; on macOS it reaches tabs opened afterwards.

history_enabled.description: Record visited pages in local history.

jev_auto.description: Run Jev on every page automatically. Off by default: it sends a digest of every page to a cloud model without the user asking.

kitsuvo_search.description: Kitsuvo Search: results pages drawn by Kitsuvo and ranked on this computer (`search.rs`). Off leaves the engine's own layout.

learn_from_corrections.description: Let the user's AI-built corrections raise the Likely line for pages without a builder fingerprint (`learning.rs`).

local_auto.description: Use the chosen Ollama text model automatically in normal public tabs.
x-prerequisites: An installed local text model; private and sign-in pages are excluded.

local_model.description: Ollama model tag for written verdicts on this computer ("qwen3:4b").

local_only.description: Refuse even the AI engines the user connected: nothing Kitsuvo itself sends leaves this computer. Pages still load, and loopback (a local model) stays allowed. See `net`.

local_vision_model.description: Optional, separately selected vision-capable Ollama model.
x-prerequisites: An installed, verified vision-capable Ollama model.

openai_model.description: OpenAI model slug; `None` picks the first listed model.

openai_source.description: Which OpenAI credential the OpenAI engine uses.

pinterest_ai_labels.description: Hide Pins that carry Pinterest's own "AI modified" label. Off by default.

qwen_chat_plugin.description: Configure qwen chat plugin. Configure through the matching reviewed setup workflow; raw object patches are refused.

read_auto.description: Open Kitsuvo's read by itself only for pages scored 40 or more and results pages with hidden results; fold it on the rest (`readpane.js`).

remote_access.description: Assistants on other computers may use the isolated agent profile through the Kitsuvo MCP relay. Off by default.
x-prerequisites: Each remote assistant identity approved separately in native UI
Remote access remains on the isolated agent profile

restore_session.description: Reopen unpinned tabs from the last session. Pinned tabs always return.

search_source.description: Where Kitsuvo Search gets results. Brave needs the user's own key and is skipped under Local only.

serp_snippet_filter.description: Opt-in SERP snippet labels; off by default and never hides results.

sidebar_dock.description: Where the sidebar sits: docked on either side, or in its own window.

sleep_after_minutes.description: Idle minutes before a background page releases its renderer, on both OSes.

sleep_tabs.description: Put tabs to sleep after they have been in the background for a while: the page is closed to free memory and reloads when the tab is shown.

spoof_warn.description: Warn before showing a page that likely impersonates a brand or asks visitors to run a command. Also lets sign-in pages be checked for impersonation on this computer; with it off they are skipped unread.

tab_sidebar_width.description: Preferred expanded tab-rail width in CSS pixels; None keeps the adaptive default.

youtube_ai_allowed_channels.description: Channels (`@handle` or `UC…` id, lowercase) whose AI-labeled videos stay visible.

youtube_ai_labels.description: Hide YouTube videos that carry YouTube's own AI disclosure label. Off by default.

tools.name: browser_find
tools.title: Find a browser instance and tab
tools.description: Read-only lookup by exact instance name, exact page URL/hostname, title or tab. Returns MATCH with a per-tab target, AMBIGUOUS, CONTROL_REQUIRED, PROTECTED_TAB or DISCOVERY_INCOMPLETE. Never attaches, selects, opens, enables control or follows focus. With browser, inspect only that consented host; without browser, inspect the configured profile registry. Preserve supplied targets unless the user requests a different instance.

tools.name: browser_instances
tools.title: Manage browser instances
tools.description: List local profile instances or create a named isolated instance without changing the visible profile. Without browser, manage instances through the configured MCP host even if a previous page target is unavailable. For an explicit request to open a new window, omit the stale browser target and use action:create with a task name. Creation starts the browser if needed and returns a browser target; attach to that target and include it on subsequent page calls. Existing instances require explicitly enabled control: discover their targets with browser_windows. Never silently replace a supplied page target or bypass Stop. Additional instances require Windows, macOS 14+, or the Linux desktop preview.

tools.name: browser_design
tools.title: Read design measurements or preview edits
tools.description: Read-only: summary gets the user's selection; query finds targets; inspect reads one target or a batch; measure returns edge gaps; css exports styles; changes reads edits. Use help for examples and limits. Read ops never open the overlay. All geometry uses CSS px in viewport coordinates. Compact JSON and structuredContent share schema_version:1. Writes: open/select/close, style/text previews, undo/revert. close keeps edits; reload discards them. Errors carry code and hint. Top-level light DOM only. Use browser_resize for responsive checks.

tools.name: browser_task
tools.title: Scoped task and human handoff
tools.description: Start an optional grant for the selected tab and its exact origin. First read-only grants narrow existing access; writes and replacement grants wait for review in Kitsuvo's assistant card. Scope and budgets cannot be raised by tools. Pause for human login/MFA/CAPTCHA/dialog help; resume only reads the state after the user continued in Kitsuvo. Take a fresh snapshot before input. Completion is not verified business success. All task grants refuse browser-wide discovery and arbitrary scripting.

tools.description: Prepare a local workflow definition for user review and saving in Kitsuvo, list task-attached workflows, or request/run one.
